title: IDOR - testing guidance
claim: Predictable object identifiers are what make an access-control flaw reachable at scale, so enumeration of the id space is part of the test rather than an optimisation.
disproof: Refuted when identifiers are non-sequential, non-guessable, and still authorised server-side: an unauthorised 200 that returns another user's object is the only evidence, not a low entropy id.

partner.quote: Insecure direct object references (IDOR) are a type of access control vulnerability that arises when an application uses user-supplied input to access objects directly.
